_comment: eTacticalComms and eSurveillance are already served by the hand-authored
tactical_communications and surveillance_systems directories and are not
duplicated. eRadar360 has its own division and is untouched.

products.title: Naval Combat Systems
products.overview: Shipboard combat management processing node handling sensor fusion, track management, and weapon assignment across a distributed naval network. Built for the shock, vibration and power-quality environment of MIL-STD-1399 shipboard service, with conduction cooling and no rotating media.
specs: Zynq UltraScale+ XCZU3EG, quad Cortex-A53 + FPGA
MIL-S-901D Grade A, Class I heavyweight
Conduction-cooled, no fans or rotating media

products.title: Maritime Defence Systems
products.overview: Coastal and harbour surveillance node fusing X-band radar returns, AIS reception, and electro-optical tracking to detect small craft that AIS alone would miss. Deployed on fixed towers and offshore platforms, feeding a maritime domain awareness picture over redundant backhaul.
specs: Dual sensor: 4K visible and LWIR thermal
pcb: ENIG, conformal coated for marine exposure
compliance: Operational and technical performance for VTS

products.title: Subsea Systems
products.overview: Subsea electronics module for ROV, AUV and seabed installation control at depths to 3000m. Uses a pressure-balanced oil-filled housing rather than a one-atmosphere vessel, which removes the dominant implosion failure mode and cuts housing mass substantially.
specs: 24-bit AD7124 for strain, pressure and temperature
pcb: ENIG, parylene coated for oil immersion

products.title: Sonar Systems
products.overview: Multi-channel sonar processing unit performing beamforming, matched filtering and classification for hull-mounted, towed-array and dipping sonar. A 64-element array is digitised at the wet end and beamformed in FPGA fabric, so array gain is not lost to analogue cable runs.
specs: Zynq UltraScale+ XCZU3EG, beamforming in fabric

products.title: Land Combat Vehicle Systems
products.overview: Vehicle electronic architecture controller implementing a NATO Generic Vehicle Architecture backbone for armoured platforms, bridging legacy CAN subsystems onto a switched Ethernet core. Survives the 28V transients of MIL-STD-1275E without shedding load, including 100V spike and 250V surge events.
specs: NATO GVA over 1GbE, plus CAN FD x8 legacy bridge
IIM-42652 high-shock IMU for hull motion
1GbE x8, CAN FD x8, RS-422 x4, 48 discrete I/O

bom.description: Discrete I/O and legacy bus bridging

products.title: C4ISR Systems
products.overview: Deployable command and control node integrating Link-16, VMF and situational awareness feeds into a common operating picture. Cross-domain guard functions run on physically separate processors so classified and unclassified enclaves never share a memory controller.
specs: Zynq UltraScale+ XCZU3EG + Jetson Orin NX for AI fusion
Physically separate enclave processors, unidirectional guard
Suite B, hardware key store, zeroise on tamper
pcb: Tamper mesh over key storage region
compliance: Tactical data link Link-16 message standard

bom.description: Secure element for Suite B key storage
PUF root of trust with tamper zeroise
Quad UART for serial data links

products.title: ISR Payload Systems
products.overview: Gimbal-mounted intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance payload combining electro-optical, thermal and laser rangefinder sensing with on-board target detection. Metadata is encoded to MISB ST 0601 in the payload, so exploitation downstream does not depend on a separate telemetry correlation step.
specs: Jetson Orin NX, 100 TOPS on-board inference
H.265 encode, STANAG 4609 with MISB ST 0601 metadata

products.title: Signals Intelligence Systems
products.overview: Wideband signals intelligence receiver performing continuous spectrum survey, emitter classification and time-difference-of-arrival geolocation. Four coherent receive channels share a common clock tree, which is what makes cross-channel phase interferometry usable for direction finding.
specs: TDOA across networked nodes, <100m CEP at 20km
Continuous IQ capture to NVMe, 2GB/s sustained
pcb: Rogers RO4350B RF layers, phase-matched channel routing

products.title: Electronic Warfare Systems
products.overview: Electronic warfare suite providing radar warning, emitter identification and coordinated countermeasure response. Threat library matching runs in FPGA fabric to keep detection-to-response latency inside the pulse repetition interval of the threats it is designed against.
pcb: Rogers RO4350B RF layers over FR-4 core

bom.description: Threat library matching and technique generation

products.title: Dismounted Soldier Systems

readme.category: Wearable soldier computing and situational awareness

products.overview: Body-worn soldier computer providing blue-force tracking, tactical messaging and heads-up situational awareness on a single battery cycle covering a 72-hour mission. Power draw was the primary design constraint, so the display and radio duty-cycle aggressively against soldier activity state.
specs: NXP i.MX 8M Plus quad Cortex-A53 with NPU
BLE 5.4 for weapon sight and helmet display
pcb: Rigid-flex to reduce interconnect failure under load

products.title: Counter-UAS Systems
products.overview: Counter-UAS node combining RF protocol detection, mmWave radar tracking and acoustic cueing to detect and classify small unmanned aircraft. Remote ID decoding per ASTM F3411 separates cooperative traffic from genuine intrusions, which keeps the false alarm rate workable in urban airspace.
specs: ASTM F3411 Bluetooth and Wi-Fi NAN decoding
On-board inference, 60 airframe and protocol classes
IP67, -30degC to +60degC, pole or vehicle mount
pcb: Rogers RO4350B RF layer over FR-4

bom.description: RF protocol detection and direction finding
Remote ID Bluetooth and Wi-Fi NAN decoding

products.title: Border Security Systems

readme.category: Unattended ground sensing and border surveillance

products.overview: Solar-powered unattended ground sensor for border and perimeter monitoring, combining seismic, magnetic, passive infrared and mmWave sensing to classify crossings as personnel, vehicle or livestock. Designed to run for five years without a site visit, which puts every design decision behind the power budget.
specs: <1 per sensor per week in field trials target
5W solar with 3.6Ah lithium buffer, 5-year design life
pcb: No electrolytics; ceramic only for 5-year life

products.title: Ruggedised Computing Platforms
products.overview: Fanless ruggedised mission computer for vehicle, airborne and dismounted deployment. Conduction cooling through the chassis removes the fan as a failure point and lets the unit be sealed to IP67, at the cost of a lower sustained thermal envelope than an equivalent forced-air design.
specs: NXP i.MX 8M Plus quad Cortex-A53 with 2.3-TOPS NPU
1GbE x4, USB 3.0 x4, CAN FD x2, RS-422 x4
pcb: Copper coin under SoC for conduction path

bom.description: TPM 2.0 secure boot and disk key

products.title: MIL-SPEC Qualification Platform
products.overview: Instrumentation platform for running MIL-STD-810H environmental and MIL-STD-461G emissions qualification campaigns, logging chamber conditions and unit-under-test telemetry against a common time base. Existing chamber controllers and spectrum analysers are integrated rather than replaced.
specs: GPIB, RS-232, LXI and Modbus TCP instrument bridge
Records instrument calibration state with each run
pcb: Guarded analogue island with isolated returns

products.title: Anti-Tamper Systems
products.overview: Anti-tamper subsystem protecting critical program information in fielded equipment, combining an active enclosure mesh, environmental monitoring and immediate key zeroisation. Detection to zeroise completes in under 50ms on the tamper battery alone, so removing main power does not defeat it.
specs: MAX32520 with SRAM PUF, no stored key material
4-layer serpentine, <100um pitch, resistance and capacitance monitored
Temperature, voltage, light and X-ray detection
Coin cell sustains tamper monitoring for 10 years
Tamper events logged to write-once FRAM with timestamp
pcb: ENIG, potted in opaque tamper-evident epoxy
Active mesh layers 2 and 9 enclosing all secret routing

bom.description: PUF root of trust with tamper zeroise
Secure element for protected key storage
Supply glitch and voltage attack detection
10-layer PCB with active tamper mesh layers

products.title: Perimeter Security Systems
products.overview: Perimeter intrusion detection system fusing fibre-optic fence disturbance sensing, mmWave zone radar and video assessment across sites of up to 20km. Distinguishing wind and wildlife from genuine climb or cut events is what determines whether an operator keeps trusting the alarms.
specs: Distributed acoustic sensing, 20km per controller, 5m resolution
Climb, cut, lean and tunnel discrimination
Wind, rain and wildlife filtering with local weather input
ONVIF Profile S video, Modbus TCP, dry contacts
pcb: Isolated field interfaces for lightning survivability

bom.description: Local weather input for nuisance rejection
Lightning surge protection on field ports
